name: mindora-mobile
description: Mindora — Learn with Dedication. Android and iOS store builds.

scripts.add:android: node ../sync-web.mjs && cap add android && npm run assets
scripts.add:ios: node ../sync-web.mjs && cap add ios && npm run assets
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
